finding_summary: Mandatory separate minor identity/account/credentials are weakened by optional workflow text and ordinarily-separate contract text.
The recovery contract may accept resulting assurance without preserving the Founder-required step-up risk-check or controlled-review condition for high-risk actions.
Input files were non-writable but CMT-01 twice observed all 13 containing directories as owner-writable 0700 so replacement or deletion was not technically prevented.

The expected Stage 2A closure commit and three cited chain commits were absent from the local object database; remote existence of the closure commit was coordinator-reported but not independently re-performed by CMT-01.
Exact active path hash and lifecycle coverage is incomplete across Identity and Relationships; Relationships also reuses source IDs for different authorities without a deterministic crosswalk.
Current approval artifacts coexist with preserved pending decision recommendation and PIA statuses without one explicit human-and-machine lifecycle precedence map.
IDENTITY-FD-005 is unmapped and multiple registered Identity mappings omit or overstate the actual FD-002 FD-004 FD-007 FD-009 FD-011 and FD-012 semantics.

Identity draft ADRs introduce RP and attestation defaults ES-AAL taxonomy numeric TOTP and step-up values opaque-session architecture and an exact recovery hierarchy/code count without a separately identifiable approved recommendation corpus.
ADR-IDENTITY-006 selects a default multi-location organization and tenancy topology owned by Business Facility Relationships Authorization Privacy and contractual domains outside Identity.
ADR-IDENTITY-007 lists a maximum paused-case duration without stating that elapsed time can never auto-complete or broaden authority during a protective exception.

Identity state/event and permission matrices omit or contradict material RecoveryCase SupportAccessSession OrganizationEnrollmentCase ProtectedAccountTransitionCase merge-reversal accepted-invitation and attributable-audit behavior.

The contract makes stale-fact denial discretionary and omits the complete authenticated acting represented approving and executing actor/evidence chain required by the approved support and attribution direction.

Protected Participant Identity-to-Relationships and Relationships-to-Authorization contracts lack closed counterpart authority and complete typed party representation-basis version dispute hold and test boundaries; finalized alignment is 0 of 12.

Several formal Relationships ADR metadata mappings do not carry the substantive higher-authority Founder rules for taxonomy organization/facility separation acceptance Care Circle emergency contact public-signup claims exceptional access default expiry and renewal revalidation.
ADR-REL-003 permits an undefined protective restricted state when a required source is inactive or disputed without proving that the state grants zero delegation-derived authority.
ADR-REL-003 limits no-silent-renewal to high-risk grants and omits automatic expiry by default plus current-authority revalidation for every renewal.
The canonical Relationship transition to unqualified VERIFIED conflicts with ADR-REL-004's prohibition on a universal verified flag and its claim purpose evidence and time-scoped assessment model.

The package claim that every first-user requirement maps through acceptance criteria tests and evidence is not mechanically demonstrated; CMT-05 found 12 Identity and 15 Relationships first-user requirements without explicit AC links.
Completion-summary ZIP filenames include _Package while frozen archive locators omit it; hashes still identify the intended bytes.
The contract requires represented principal on all calls although the approved Identity requirement makes representation conditional.
Textually identical Identity-to-Relationships contract bodies carry different package lifecycle status strings.
ADR-REL-003 ADR-REL-004 and ADR-REL-006 titles drift across candidate and later stages while stage-local ID/title parity remains exact.
Formal Relationships ADR wording gives Identity ownership of representation truth without limiting it to attributed session context or preserving source-basis authority ownership.
Accountable-human ownership is classified for general production although first-user flows already use scheduled system actors.
REL-GP-006 names different scenarios across frozen stages and the CMT-07 Identity denominator does not map one-to-one to the five packaged Identity golden paths.
